notes: works in the HMD (confirmed 2026-10-30, `sparse = 1`, after the `vkQueueBindSparse` replay fix; a later start the same evening crashed after 26 s: `[vrdual] SIGSEGV ip 0x7fc72537c68a`, cause not checked, the log was overwritten by the next start; after a restart it worked again). A dedicated mod exists: [witcher3-vr](https://github.com/tig3rmast3r/witcher3-vr) (next-gen DX12 v4.0.4, Windows, OpenXR) and its fork [joschi127/witcher3-vr](https://github.com/joschi127/witcher3-vr) (also Remastered 5.01, and Linux under Proton + WiVRn via `wineopenxr`, see its `LINUX.md`); made for this one game (engine hooks: head-tracked camera, first person, HUD on its own layer), it may well give a better result. What vrdual took from it: [shader rules](tasks/shader-rules.md). vrdual is generic (any game, no mod) and runs on Linux, with each eye rendered in full on its own GPU. History: earlier sessions were not stable. Fixed on the way: the mirror's twin device failed with -7 (vkd3d enables `VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2`, which RADV offers only by drirc to engine `vkd3d`; the twin instance now carries the app's name and engine). vkd3d gives D3D12 feature level 12_0 only with sparse residency (Tiled Resources Tier 2), which the layer hides by default, hence the new `sparse` key. Stability: one start hung ~1 s after the swapchain (black screen, render thread spinning without syscalls; no stack taken); one session ran ~8 min (~140 submits/s, mirror sync 0.6 ms over 483 MB), and 21 s after the game exited **06:00.0 hung** (`ring sdma0 test failed`, SMU no response, reset failed), machine reboot. Suspects: the `vkQueueBindSparse` replay on B (was a generated wrapper without `qlock` and fence tracking; hand-written since 2026-10-30, not re-tested in the game), vkd3d's copy queue (SDMA) on 06. Next: the game with `sparse = 1` and `VRDUAL_EYE` unset (is 06 stable without the layer?), 2026-10-27
